topic: Automating the monthly sales report from your spreadsheets

sources.markdown:
# Time spent on reporting

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Finance staff in small companies reported spending between six and ten hours each month assembling the same sales report.

# Spreadsheet errors

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.
